title: Collect framework traces without duplicate enrichment
goal: Collect native ASP.NET Core request spans once, preserve application enrichment, and migrate exporters that depend on older HTTP tags, conventional routes or exception status descriptions.

runtime.reason: Actual .NET 11 RC2 execution, not GA verification.
runtime.name: .NET

language.reason: Explicit sample language mode; .NET 10 comparison uses C# 14. No experimental language feature.
language.name: C#

packages.reason: Actual exported-span verification pin. Older comparison additionally uses OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AspNetCore 1.20.1; newer HTTP-only pipeline omits it.
packages.name: OpenTelemetry

packageAssets: OpenTelemetry 1.20.1 and transitive OpenTelemetry.Api/ProviderBuilderExtensions 1.20.1 compatible managed assets, verified by both locked restores. .NET 10 additionally references OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AspNetCore 1.20.1. No EF/database/provider assets.
providers: Kestrel loopback server; no database or external resource provider.
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; actual managed Windows x64 execution. No browser, cloud account or remote collector required.
renderingModes: Server HTTP endpoints; no Blazor rendering mode.
prerequisites: Use a separate directory for each complete sample below, retaining its SDK/project/package boundary. Restore required packs/packages before the sample runs. Installed Playbook guidance itself is fully offline.
Fixtures bind ephemeral loopback ports and stop their hosts. Certificates are temporary and are not added to shared trust stores.
constraints: Subscribe to Microsoft.AspNetCore, not the activity operation name Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.HttpRequestIn. Use one provider and export pipeline. Preserve non-HTTP instrumentation separately. The suppression switch is not a general rollback: RC2 removes native route/tags and error status, keeps span creation and does not restore exception StatusDescription. Native RC2 emits error.type but no exception event in this fixture; inspect actual exporter inputs.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API intent for .NET 11, verified with RC2 under ADR 0004. Final GA reconciliation remains pending; RC2 differences are disclosed in the body.

sources.title: Official ASP.NET Core 11 capability and migration reference

evidence.scope: Actual .NET 10.0.13 MVC success/error requests through OpenTelemetry and AspNetCore instrumentation 1.20.1, with a custom domain processor/exporter. Exactly two distinct server spans, source identity, domain enrichment, method tag, raw conventional route template and Error/null description asserted. No fresh-process suppression, resolved-route or error.type assertion is claimed on this target.

Actual .NET 11 RC2 MVC success/error requests through OpenTelemetry 1.20.1 with a custom domain processor/exporter and no AspNetCore instrumentation dependency. Exactly two distinct native server spans, source identity, domain enrichment, method/response tags, resolved conventional routes, Error/null description and error.type asserted. Fresh-process suppression asserts absent native HTTP/route tags, Unset error status, continued spans/domain tags and null description. No remote collector or metric execution claim.

humanProof.scope: All focused checks ran on the authoring machine without owner-only access. This does not settle product-wide or GA publication gates.
